name: JARVIS
description: Industrial-grade autonomous personal AI assistant (AI operating layer) with FastAPI backend, secure sandbox execution, layered SQLite/LanceDB memory, WebSocket streaming telemetry, and cinematic Stark Industries HUD.
conventions: All core modules are pure Python in /core/
Imports within core/ use relative module imports (e.g., from sandbox import secure_execute)
All external commands execute through secure_execute() with regex-based security policy
Telemetry endpoint returns reactor stability, CPU load, neural mesh status, memory backend, thread count, and security status
architecture_patterns: Single-file FastAPI app in /core/server.py with modular imports
Layered memory: SQLite for relational/audit, LanceDB for vector semantic recall
Proactive daemon threads for autonomous health monitoring
Security-first: regex-based command policy enforcement before execution
WebSocket streaming for real-time bidirectional communication

file_structure.core/server.py: FastAPI backend - intent routing, SQLite persistence, WebSocket streaming
file_structure.core/hermes_bridge.py: HTTP bridge server for Hermes Agent MCP integration
file_structure.core/heartbeat.py: Proactive background daemon for system health monitoring
file_structure.core/vision.py: Multimodal screen capture for visual telemetry
file_structure.core/reflection.py: Trajectory logging and self-improving reflection storage
file_structure.core/sandbox.py: Secure command execution with regex-based security policy
file_structure.ui/hud.html: Cinematic Stark Industries HUD with dual-canvas SVG helmet, voice loop

patterns: Unit tests for sandbox security policy enforcement
Unit tests for secure command execution
Unit tests for reflection memory storage/retrieval
Unit tests for vision screen capture
Integration tests for FastAPI endpoints (telemetry, command, WebSocket)
Integration tests for Hermes bridge HTTP API

sprint_focus: Continue JARVIS industrial architecture: fix sandbox timeout for test suite execution, add missing test modules (test_sandbox, test_reflection, test_vision, test_heartbeat), install LanceDB for vector memory, validate output with ASE.
never_do: Never execute commands without security policy regex check
Never store secrets in committed files
Never use shell=True in subprocess calls - use shlex.split for safe parsing
Never hardcode absolute paths that differ from /home/thor/Desktop/JARVIS
preferred_patterns: Use regex-based security policy for all command execution
Use parameterized SQL queries to prevent injection
Use shlex.split for safe command parsing
Log all sandboxed executions to audit_trail.log
Use SQLite for persistence, LanceDB for vector memory
